title: Sayonara Wild Hearts
provenance: Reported by atkgitxp (upstream#45, 2026-09-14), Apple M4 Pro, macOS 26.6.2, KLYC-Box 0.9.9, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r2, DXMT, rated 5 of 5 after 10 minutes. The same reporter confirmed on upstream#182 (2026-09-30) that the KLYC-Box 0.10.1 beta, engine r15, fixed the input and audio after switching apps. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Reported perfect on DXMT on the default engine. Before engine r15, switching to another app lost the audio and the keyboard and mouse. The reporter confirmed that r15 fixes it.

knownIssues.symptom: Switching to another app while the game runs loses audio and keyboard and mouse input, on engines before r15
knownIssues.cause: The fault found in Unity games on the Wine 10 engines. The Mac driver left Unity believing it had no focus after a switch, and a Unity game without focus ignores input
knownIssues.fix: Fixed in engine r15, confirmed by the reporter on KLYC-Box 0.10.1. Environments on the default engine pick it up by themselves once Steam is closed
